def f(A):
    h,w=len(A),len(A[0]); out=[r[:] for r in A]
    ones=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if A[i][j]==1]
    rs=[p[0] for p in ones]; cs=[p[1] for p in ones]
    rmin,rmax,cmin,cmax=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    closed=all(A[i][j]==1 for i in range(rmin,rmax+1) for j in (cmin,cmax)) and \
           all(A[rmin][j]==1 and A[rmax][j]==1 for j in range(cmin,cmax+1))
    if not closed: return out
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if A[i][j]!=0: continue
            adj=any(0<=i+di<h and 0<=j+dj<w and A[i+di][j+dj]==1 for di in (-1,0,1) for dj in (-1,0,1) if (di or dj))
            stripy=rmin<i<rmax and cmin<j<cmax
            out[i][j]=3 if (stripy or adj) else 0
    return out

def f(A):
    h,w=len(A),len(A[0]); out=[r[:] for r in A]
    ones=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if A[i][j]==1]
    rmin,rmax,cmin,cmax=min(p[0] for p in ones),max(p[0] for p in ones),min(p[1] for p in ones),max(p[1] for p in ones)
    # closed ring: every cell on the bbox border segment is 1
    if not (all(A[rmin][j]==1 for j in range(cmin,cmax+1)) and all(A[rmax][j]==1 for j in range(cmin,cmax+1)) and all(A[i][cmin]==1 for i in range(rmin,rmax+1)) and all(A[i][cmax]==1 for i in range(rmin,rmax+1))):
        return out
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if A[i][j]!=0: continue
            adj=any(0<=i+di<h and 0<=j+dj<w and A[i+di][j+dj]==1 for di in (-1,0,1) for dj in (-1,0,1) if (di or dj))
            stripy=rmin<i<rmax and cmin<j<cmax
            out[i][j]=3 if adj and stripy else (2 if adj else 0)
    return out

from collections import deque
def components(A,val=1):
    h,w=len(A),len(A[0]); seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]; res=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if A[i][j]==val and not seen[i][j]:
                st=[(i,j)]; seen[i][j]=True; c=[]
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop(); c.append((a,b))
                    for di,dj in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        n=(a+di,b+dj)
                        if 0<=n[0]<h and 0<=n[1]<w and A[n[0]][n[1]]==val and not seen[n[0]][n[1]]:
                            seen[n[0]][n[1]]=True; st.append(n)
                res.append(c)
    return res
